title: Wire the run route to EpicReconcilerWorkflow
description:
EpicReconcilerWorkflow is bound (wrangler.toml) but nothing under cloudflare/src calls EPIC_RECONCILER.create. runs.ts:244/606 still start RUN_WORKFLOW, which boots a container agent.

Until this lands, every other Phase 4 component is unreachable in production and the Phase 4 gate cannot be performed at all. It is the first tick of this epic for that reason.

From pxc, finding ea78c31c.
acceptance_criteria: A run started through the normal route is driven by EpicReconcilerWorkflow, and a test fails if runs.ts starts RUN_WORKFLOW for an epic run
